context: Treat this as a dependent local-process refactor, separate from required workflow wiring. First classify existing `ci-lint` guards as universal, skill-relevant, or product-only and pin the inventory in tests. Then add/reuse a `skill-integrity-check` Make target and choose commands from one classifier decision. Preserve product behavior exactly and run both contracts for mixed diffs.
description:
After the required skill-integrity CI lane lands, local `make pr-preflight` will still run `ci-lint` unconditionally before its existing path-gated fast tests. Narrow the local process only after inventorying every lint guard: pure skill diffs should run the mandatory provenance, mirror, instruction, identity, wrapper, and artifact controls without unrelated product lint/type/quality checks; product and unknown diffs retain current full behavior. Consume `scripts/path_filter_decision.py` JSON and path lists rather than creating shell path rules. Delete-only and mixed diffs must remain fail-closed, and an unavailable trusted verifier must fail rather than print a successful skip.

This item has a hard sequencing prerequisite on `behind-pr-occurrence-01-pr-open-currency`: do not edit `Makefile` until PR #1755 is merged, then fetch/rebase onto that `develop` before implementation. The tracker CLI currently cannot add an item dependency through `todo update`, so this textual prerequisite is binding. Local skill classification may compare with current `origin/develop`, but publication must still pass 01's `git merge-base --is-ancestor origin/develop HEAD` gate.

Regression coverage must prove this refactor does not remove or bypass the ancestry gate, consume `STALE=1` internally, run `git merge origin/develop` inside `pr-open`, make `pr-fanout` refresh multiple worktrees, arm auto-merge at open, or treat branch ancestry as a skill/product classification dimension. `make pr-refresh` remains the only default one-PR absorb and `make pr-ready` remains the normal arm path.

anti_patterns.dont: copy skill path globs into Makefile or shell conditionals
anti_patterns.instead: consume the existing classifier JSON and generated path lists
anti_patterns.why: parallel classifiers drift and eventually disagree about safety

anti_patterns.dont: make all ci-lint guards conditional without an inventory and behavioral pins
anti_patterns.instead: separate universal, skill-relevant, and product-only guards explicitly
anti_patterns.why: the current unconditional target includes identity and artifact controls that must not disappear

anti_patterns.dont: optimize content-only or post-merge ci-lint in this item
anti_patterns.instead: limit scope to pure/mixed skill local preflight after the CI contract exists
anti_patterns.why: broader lint decomposition requires separate evidence and increases regression risk

anti_patterns.dont: treat a missing local skill-sync CLI as a successful skip
anti_patterns.instead: verify the required pin or build the trusted verifier in a temporary cache and fail if unavailable
anti_patterns.why: the current skip branch provides no integrity evidence

preserves.behavior: Commit-range identity, source trust, instruction authority, lock/mirror integrity, wrapper contracts, and artifact hygiene remain mandatory for skill diffs

Product, unknown, empty, and mixed product diffs retain the existing full local lint and fast-test contract
Required GitHub workflow and ruleset behavior are unchanged by this local-only process item
Unavailable trusted skill verification fails selected skill preflight instead of silently succeeding
